needs_human.note: The search-mode URL sync in FolderBrowser now skips `router.replace` when the rebuilt params equal the current URL's (FolderBrowser.tsx:451). This affects every search page and is not in the spec.

FolderBrowser's search-mode URL sync now skips router.replace when the rebuilt params string equals the current URL's. That changes behaviour beyond the declared touch points. It holds only when the existing URL has the same parameters in the same order; any difference, such as order or extra parameters, still triggers a replace as before.
